locations.name: Mothers' Courtyard
locations.notes: CONDITIONAL design approval; two visual faults to correct; on hold for compositions

memories.title: They Were Saying the Child's Name

fragments.place: flat stone with bowls, one newer than the rest
fragments.object: strip of indigo and earth striped cloth tied among the white ones
fragments.sound: voices under the insects saying one name, Adanna's
fragments.interaction: Adanna reties the cloth where it has slipped

memories.visual_identity: Green dawn mist, cool forest light.

memories.title: What Was Asked For

fragments.place: the one clean lake in a rust-stained kingdom
fragments.object: two drinking gourds side by side on the bank, and a third, very small
fragments.sound: a man and a woman talking low across water

memories.visual_identity: Blue light off clear water on two faces; no flame.

memories.title: The Meal They Could Not Finish
memories.establishes: Nneka and Ezeani faced an impossible decision

fragments.object: a small sixth bowl, a child's, clean on the shelf
fragments.sound: a child chattering through a silence
fragments.interaction: Adanna sets the small bowl with the others

memories.visual_identity: Colour returning through grey ash for the length of the memory, then draining.

memories.title: Do Not Answer

fragments.object: a child's bead bracelet tied to a pole under years of white strips
fragments.sound: a girl's laughter, and under it a name called from the water

memories.visual_identity: Silver rain on the river, white cloth, everything wet.

memories.title: What He Swore Afterwards
memories.establishes: Adanna's childhood memories were incomplete for a reason

fragments.object: one rod set apart, with an ivory bracelet fused to it by lightning
fragments.sound: a man's voice, steady, under thunder; the words are not made out
fragments.interaction: Adanna lays her hand on the rod during a strike

memories.visual_identity: Seen only in lightning flashes, each a frozen image.

memories.title: The Day, at Six Years Old
memories.establishes: Ezeani's actions were more complicated than Adanna understood

fragments.object: one thing in the room that is on the wrong side each time
fragments.sound: Nneka saying Adanna's name, the voice that called her into the forest
fragments.interaction: Adanna puts the object where it truly was

memories.visual_identity: Camera at a child's eye height throughout; sourceless dusk indigo.

memories.title: The Last Night
memories.establishes: Nneka offered herself; Ezeani carried out the killing; both hid the truth, in different ways

fragments.object: Nneka's striped wrapper, folded, the one thing in the land of the dead that has kept its colour
fragments.sound: the low talk of the second memory, the same two voices, older

memories.visual_identity: Plain lamplight in an ordinary room, the only warm light in Chapter 7.

chapter_rules.statement: The lone giant tree on the horizon is the Great Root Mother's territory and must be visible from every major clearing.
The great tree is a living silk-cotton (kapok) with full crown and plank buttresses; the approach V003 board governs the model.
No living flame anywhere in the kingdom until the boss; the kingdom is cold. Light only from roof cracks.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 chapter manifest validation + art review

chapter_rules.statement: No remains are ever shown. Objects are put down, not thrown. Faces in the palace are scraped away.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 chapter manifest validation + art review

chapter_rules.statement: Ash must not read as snow.
Pythons are never enemies and never loot in Idemili's domain. They may appear as ambient wildlife and signs of her presence. Royal python markings only.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 spawn table validation + L2 runtime spawn assertion

chapter_rules.statement: No lightning in Chapter 4; it is kept for Amadioha.
Houses stand on the ground in the same building tradition as elsewhere, never on stilts.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 chapter manifest validation + art review

chapter_rules.statement: No combat at the shrine. Idemili's presence is shown by water, chalk, white cloth and the python, never by an image or a face.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 encounter validation + L2 runtime assertion

chapter_rules.statement: Lightning is white only, never coloured. Nothing is built on the mountain; people only cut rock or drive iron into it.
A West African granite dome, never an alpine peak: no snow, no conifers. The storm never leaves the summit and the summit is visible in every board.

All face coverings are invented and featureless: a smooth oval with two eye slits at most. No horns, paint, raffia, crests or any feature of a real masquerade. Needs consultant review before further development.
Face coverings must not drift to round discs or forms with a nose ridge. Nothing is monstrous; the place is wrong only in small ways.

The stronghold of the dead is earth, timber and cloth burnt hard like fired clay, never a stone castle. Ember red only deep in cracks, never flame. Grey burial cloth, no ferryman, no figures, no remains. Sky starless.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: L0 chapter manifest validation + art review

chapter_rules.statement: Okwu's hood shows darkness only, in every light, always. No face, no stone.
Adanna's features are never mirrored or moved. Left: cheekbone scar, three bronze braid cuffs + two coral beads at temple, single shoulder guard, coiled armlet, blade at hip. Right side plain.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: character validation test (sockets, no mirrored mesh)

chapter_rules.statement: Adanna carries exactly one weapon: a short leaf-bladed iron sword about 60 cm, worn on the left hip. No spear, no second weapon, no wrist bracelets.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: inventory data validation + character validation test

chapter_rules.statement: Invented mythology must never be presented as authentic Igbo tradition. Depictions of Amadioha, Idemili and the land of the dead are fiction and must be labelled as such in codex and credits.
chapter_rules.enforced_by: codex data validation (bFictionalMythology flag) + credits review
